6. Churrascaria Vulcao, LLC
     Churrascaria Vulcao, LLC , D/B/A: Churrascaria Vulcao, Location: 203 ADAMS ST
     DORCHESTER, MA 02122,
     License#: LB‑336046, Notice/Violation#: CANCELLATION HEARING, Category:
     CV7MWN
     Date            Notice
     02/19/2021 The Board held mandatory informational hearings on October 6, 2020 and
     December 1, 2020 (the Licensee failed to appear at the December hearing despite
     receiving notice). The Board also held a mandatory informational hearing on January 12,
     2021 at which the Licensee was put on notice of the potential cancellation of the License
     due to the alleged change in beneficial interest and management effectively transferring
     the License without the Board’s approval. Further, the Licensee was put on notice that the
     landlord of the Licensed Premise has informed the Board the Licensee no longer has the
     legal right to occupy the premise. The attorney for the Licensee stated at the January 12,
     2021 hearing that should the Licensee and the landlord not reach an agreement within
     thirty (30) days the Licensee was aware the License would be cancelled. The Board has
     not received any subsequent information from the Licensee.
CANCELLED
ambiguity_notes: The source describes an alleged unapproved beneficial-interest/management change. The cancellation decision does not verify that a sale or transfer closed.
